doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: On the road in the late 1940s and 1950s
summary: Touring was fun, by station wagon with a small group, and more fun now.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: My. So, what was it like, I don’t know if you can describe what it’s like being on the road, in the late ‘40s and early ‘50s?
Oh it was fun. It was a lot of fun.
You traveled mostly by bus? Or car?
Because you had a fairly small group at that time.
Did you have agents that set up your work for you?
Yeah. It was a lot of fun. But it’s more fun now.
